title: Siege of Barcelona (1705)
summary:
The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Barcelona (1705)", at revision 1370739268, opens: "The siege of Barcelona took place between 14 September and 19 October 1705 during the War of the Spanish Succession when a multinational Grand Alliance army led by Lord Peterborough, supporting the Habsburg pretender to the Spanish throne, captured the city of Barcelona from its Spanish Bourbonic defenders,
most of whom then joined the Habsburg army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q638462, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1705 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
